service.title: Service
service.description: How the agent answers on this connection's inboxes. An inbox may have its own adjustment.

hints.grouping_seconds: Messages the contact sends in a row get one answer. From 0 to 30.
hints.max_messages: Longer answers are joined in the last message. From 1 to 5.
hints.max_chars: Guidance to the agent for short texts. From 100 to 1,000.
hints.interval_ms: Pause between the messages of one answer. Up to 5,000.
hints.voice_reply: When the contact sends audio, the agent answers in audio, if the agent's voice key allows it.

voiceReply.mirror: Answer in audio whoever sent audio

service.backToBot: After a handoff, the conversation returns to the agent when the team sets it back to "pending" in Chatwoot.
service.reset: The inbox uses the default again.

meta.title: Link a WhatsApp number (Meta)
meta.description: Each conversation of the number becomes a room, one per person. The chosen GUIDS answers, and the history stays in the room even if you change who answers.
meta.embeddedHint: Sign in with the company's Facebook account, pick (or create) the WhatsApp Business account and the number, and come back with the number linked.
meta.embeddedUnavailable: Available once the GUIDU app on Meta is configured. For now, link the number manually.
meta.manualHint: In Meta's Business Manager, create a system user with access to the WhatsApp account and generate a permanent token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management. The token is encrypted and never shown again.
meta.created: Number linked. Choose the GUIDS that answers it.
meta.routeHint: Changing it does not move the conversations: they stay in the same rooms.
meta.routeCleared: The number has nobody to answer it.
